scope: Gateway app/automation/monitoring + WF16 Main only; fixed machine GET health, durable hashed audit receipt per15min, zero Native/model/credential/Staging changes; short Gateway restart
qualification: Deploy Gateway then WF16 single-date cron probe; first receipt must appear after cron without manual invocation; always restore15min schedule
rollback: First restore private WF16 snapshot with cron disabled; restore previous Gateway AI_IMAGE only; preserve business/cache/daily/outbox/audit data, never restore DB or replay writes
limits: Gateway cgroup metrics and mounted storage, not host-wide GPU/CPU utilization
One local embedding per15min, no external provider call
No external notifications; health does not certify DR or full release readiness
